notes.title: Two new maps
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31806038/51eb22c98ebb51eca876dd087adb6b51e732bff4.png[/img]

Good News Everyone!

The long awaited update for HorD - High or Die has finally arrived. It features a lot of bug fixes, performance improvements and most of all this:

[list]
    [*]Harbor Level
    [*]Disco Level
    [*]Codex - Informations about Items and Enemies
[/list]

Have fun playing

hOSHI* & Flowmasters

notes.title: New killable Enemy (Nightmare)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31806038/8ed30bba3f107784fef50d153bd0ef286e65ec2a.png[/img]

Good News!

There is a new version of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/777360/HorD_High_or_Die/]HorD: High or Die[/url] online now. Beyond other bugfixes and improvements there is one mayor new feature: You will now be able to kill the feared [b]Nightmare[/b] enemy earning more points than ever before.

Here is the complete list of changes:

[list]
    [*]Changed the invincible Nightmare enemy type to a killable, reoccurring miniboss with a high amount of HP.
    [*]The HUD now gives feedback if the Flowmotion can be used an witch button has to be pressed.
    [*]Added full controller support for XBox and Steamlink controller
    [*]Added keyboard controls to the main menu
    [*]Fixed a bug which caused some of the enemies to survive the RAAAAGE onslaught.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the players had to replay the tutorial with every playthrough.
    [*]Fixed minor bugs and slightly improved the performance of the game.
[/list]

Have fun

hOSHI* and the Flowmasters
